text: As a part of the King / Queen / Queensway / Roncesvalles (KQQR) road reconstruction work, St. Joseph's Health Centre (SJHC) has requested that emergency service vehicles have full access to the SJHC Melynk driveway, located on The Queensway between Glendale Ave and Sunnyside Ave. Engineering & Construction Services (ECS), in consultation with TTC and Transportation Services Traffic Operations, have reviewed and agree with installing curb depressions on The Queensway to accommodate emergency service vehicles. To deter regular vehicular traffic from entering the TTC track allowance, the curb depressions will be offset with the south side curb depression located further west.

City Council on June 15 and 16, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit eastbound and southbound left turns at all times at the intersection of The Queensway and the private driveway at 30 The Queensway, located on the north side of The Queensway, approximately 90 metres west of Sunnyside Avenue, emergency vehicles excepted.
